summary: PR #3 introduces premium subscriptions (plans, checkout, entitlements, premium todo features). It is the largest and riskiest change: client-side price/entitlement checks, a hardcoded test key, and missing server-side verification create high-severity billing-bypass risks, with no tests for upgrade/downgrade, webhook, or entitlement edge cases. Requires security rework before merge.

issues.message: Subscription price taken from client request body and trusted for charge creation; attacker can set price to 1 cent.
issues.suggestion: Look up price server-side from PLAN_PRICES by planId; never accept amount from the client.

issues.message: Premium gate checked only in the UI (isPremium flag in localStorage); API routes serve premium features without verification.
issues.suggestion: Enforce entitlements server-side on every premium route via requirePremium middleware verifying Stripe subscription status.

issues.message: Hardcoded Stripe secret key committed to source.
issues.suggestion: Remove key, rotate it immediately, and read from process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY via the secret manager.

issues.message: Stripe webhook handler skips signature verification, allowing forged subscription events.
issues.suggestion: Verify with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, sig, webhookSecret) before mutating entitlements.

issues.message: Plan matrix duplicated between frontend and backend with no shared source; drift risk.
issues.suggestion: Share a single PLANS definition imported by both, or generate the UI list from the API.

issues.message: Premium export loads all todos into memory for CSV generation; unbounded for large accounts.
issues.suggestion: Stream rows with pagination/cursors and cap export size with a documented limit.

codeQuality.summary: Four high-severity billing/security findings (client-trusted price, client-only gates, leaked secret, unverified webhooks) plus plan drift and export scalability. Applied security-analysis skill checklist and must-fix billing rules.

suggestions.testCase: given planId "pro" with body amount 1, assert server charges 999 (plan price) and ignores client amount.
given an event with invalid signature, assert 400 and no entitlement change; given valid signature, assert upgrade applied.
given an expired subscription, premium route returns 403; assert free-tier route still 200.
given 0 todos, returns header-only CSV; given 50k todos, streams without OOM; assert row count and quoting of commas.
given planId "nope", assert throws PlanNotFound with code 404.

testCoverage.summary: Billing paths have effectively no automated coverage; the five suggestions above are the minimum merge-blocking set, ordered by financial risk.

suggestions.description: Introduce a server-authoritative pricing service (getPlanPrice(planId)) and a requirePremium middleware to centralize billing policy.
suggestions.example: async function requirePremium(req,res,next){ const sub = await getActiveSubscription(req.user.id); if(!sub) return res.sendStatus(403); next(); }

suggestions.description: Unify duplicated plan matrix into a single shared PLANS module consumed by UI and API.
suggestions.example:
export const PLANS = { free:{price:0,...}, pro:{price:999,...} };
// UI: Object.entries(PLANS).map(renderPlan)

suggestions.description: Replace in-memory CSV string building with async generator streaming.
suggestions.example: async function* todoRows(userId){ let cur=null; while(true){ const page=await listTodos(userId,{cursor:cur}); if(!page.length) break; yield* page; cur=page.at(-1).id; } }

deadCode: src/billing/legacy.js: entire module superseded by checkout.js (still imported nowhere)
refactoring.summary: Billing logic is scattered across UI/API with duplicated plans; centralizing pricing + entitlements and streaming exports modernizes the structure.

recommendations: BLOCKER: stop trusting client price; verify plan server-side and rotate the leaked Stripe key.
BLOCKER: verify Stripe webhook signatures and enforce premium gates server-side.
Add billing regression tests (tampered price, forged webhook, expired sub) before merge.
Unify the plan matrix into one shared module; stream large CSV exports.
Remove src/billing/legacy.js and other dead premium code.
